blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Prosecution and defense counsels in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte on Thursday bickered over an “expert” witness called to testify on supposed money laundering allegations against the vice president. According to defense counsel Mark Vinluan, their witness, Atty. Rainer Dela Fuente, could enlighten the impeachment court on fundamental legal concepts related to the Anti-Money Laundering Act through his knowledge and experience as a certified public accountant, lawyer and anti-money laundering compliance practitioner. The witness’ testimony would also prove that the findings of Duterte’s alleged unexplained wealth were “erroneous, malicious, and without merit,” Vinluan added. READ: […]...
